newsitem.title: MEXICO: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa initiated as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Ahmsa initiated as buy.

text.p: Credit Lyonnais Securities said in a research report on Monday it was initiating coverage of Mexican steelmaker Altos Hornos de Mexico (Ahmsa) S.A. de C.V. with a buy recommendation.

-- Analyst Harald Liberge wrote the recommendation was based on potential upside for the share price which "does not reflect the excellent benefits of the modernization program the company has been carrying out since 1992."
-- Liberge situated Ahmsa's 12-month share price target at 20.30 in constant pesos.
-- Liberge noted the company was highly leveraged, but added "we expect Ahmsa's cash floew to largely cover the company's interest expense."
-- Ahmsa shares were down two centavos to 18.18 pesos in early trade on the Mexican bourse.
